name: Sun Cleric: Guiding Glow already grants Dawn extra charges (#1565)
contract: Both ranks' effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), MiscValue 4 = SPELLMOD_CHARGES, EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 0x40, matching Dawn's (807440) own SpellFamilyFlags word 0 (0x40, the same bit rank 2 of Leap of the Valkyrie also matches). Dawn's own ProcCharges is 10. Rank 1's BasePoints 2 resolves to 3 (DieSides 1), matching 'Allows Dawn to affect 3 additional casts'; rank 2's BasePoints 4 resolves to 5, matching '5 additional casts'. Native SPELLMOD_CHARGES, applied wherever Player::ApplySpellMod(Dawn, SPELLMOD_CHARGES, ...) is read (Dawn's own ProcCharges lookup). Native only, no server code needed.

steps.label: Dawn's own charge count before the talent
Rank 1: Allows Dawn to affect 3 additional casts
Rank 2 replaces rank 1: Allows Dawn to affect 5 additional casts
